name: TrafficLab-3D
description: Create a digital-twin style traffic visualization using only mp4 CCTV footage and its Google Maps location.
readme_summary: TrafficLab 3D is a Python-based tool that creates a digital-twin style traffic visualization from standard MP4 CCTV footage and its Google Maps location. It aims to make advanced computer vision accessible for students and enthusiasts without requiring complex camera calibration or synchronized satellite imagery.
key_features: Digital-twin style traffic visualization
Utilizes only MP4 CCTV footage and Google Maps location
Accessibility for students and enthusiasts
Supports custom SVG for projection mapping
Modular architecture for easy swapping of object detection and tracking models
End-to-end traffic analysis suite
primary_use_case: To generate a 3D digital twin visualization of traffic from everyday CCTV footage and its geographical location, making advanced traffic analysis accessible.
cover_image_prompt: A digital artist meticulously painting a vibrant, 3D cityscape onto a blank canvas using a tablet. The canvas is a projection showing real-time traffic flow from a CCTV camera feed, with cars and pedestrians clearly visible and tracked. The artist uses a stylus that glows with data particles, transforming the raw CCTV footage (represented by a small, grainy video player screen in the corner) into a detailed, interactive 3D model. Subtle UI elements and code snippets are integrated into the artist's workspace, hinting at the underlying technology. The scene is set in a modern, well-lit studio with a focus on the creative process of building the digital twin. The style is a 3D isometric illustration with clean lines and a bright, engaging color palette, emphasizing the transformation of simple input into a complex, insightful output.

name: globalthreatmap
description: Global threat map. Learn wars, conflicts, military bases and history of nations.
readme_summary: Global Threat Map is a real-time situational awareness platform that visualizes security events, geopolitical developments, and threat indicators on an interactive map. It functions as an OSINT command center, providing detailed country intelligence, military base visualization, and an alert system.
key_features: Real-Time Event Mapping
Interactive Mapbox Map
Event Feed
Intel Dossiers
Alert System
Country Intelligence (Historical & Current Conflicts)
Military Bases Layer (US & NATO)
AI-Powered Analysis
Map Visualization (Auto-Pan, Clustering, Heatmap)
primary_use_case: Providing real-time global situational awareness and intelligence on security events, conflicts, and geopolitical developments.
cover_image_prompt: A high-level strategic command center overlooking a holographic globe. The globe is dynamically displaying clusters of glowing red and yellow markers representing real-time security events and conflicts, with lines connecting them to show geopolitical tensions. Small screens around the room show data feeds, intel dossiers, and military base icons. A central figure, representing an OSINT analyst, points to a specific region on the globe, initiating an AI-powered deep research report visualized as unfolding digital scrolls. The overall mood is one of urgent, informed vigilance. The style is a futuristic, clean digital painting with a dark, high-tech color palette and subtle glowing elements.

name: IMSI-catcher
description: This program show you IMSI numbers of cellphones around you.
readme_summary: This Python program, IMSI-catcher, utilizes SDR receivers to detect and display IMSI numbers, along with country, brand, and operator information, of nearby cellphones. It is designed for educational purposes to understand GSM network functionality.
key_features: Detects IMSI numbers of nearby cellphones
Displays country, brand, and operator information
Utilizes SDR receivers (RTL-SDR, HackRF, etc.)
Works with Gnu/Linux systems
Provides options for saving data to SQLite, TXT, or MySQL
Includes tools for scanning frequencies and monitoring GSM signals
primary_use_case: Educational tool for understanding GSM network operation and cellphone identification.
cover_image_prompt: A stylized, transparent globe with faint radio waves emanating from it. Within the globe, tiny, abstract representations of cellphones are visible, each with a small, glowing tag displaying an 'IMSI' number. A friendly, stylized robot character is shown holding a magnifying glass, peering intently at one of the phone tags, with subtle UI elements of signal strength and network data floating around it. The background is a clean, dark blue gradient, with the repository name 'IMSI-catcher' subtly integrated into the lower corner. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with a focus on clarity and a slightly futuristic, educational aesthetic.

name: afterkey
description: utility for displaying pressed keys directly on the monitor for MacOS, Windows, Linux
readme_summary: AfterKey is a cross-platform utility that displays pressed keyboard keys on the screen as translucent buttons. It offers customization for appearance and behavior, with system tray integration.
key_features: Translucent key overlay with modifier support
Configurable position, colors, font size, border, opacity
System tray integration
Adjustable display duration and max visible keys
primary_use_case: Displaying pressed keys on screen for recording, streaming, or accessibility purposes.
cover_image_prompt: A minimalist, ethereal scene where a user's hands are typing on a keyboard. As each key is pressed, a soft, glowing, translucent button representing that key briefly appears on the screen above the keyboard, mirroring the keystroke. The buttons are clean and modern, showing the key label clearly. Subtle digital particles emanate from the keys, suggesting the flow of information. The overall mood is calm and informative, with a clean background and soft lighting. The repository name 'AfterKey' is subtly integrated into the UI of one of the on-screen key buttons. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a focus on clarity and a modern aesthetic.

name: Crab-Code-IDE
description: Crab Code The best AI IDE
readme_summary: CrabCode is a cross-platform AI development environment built with Electron, React, and TypeScript. It integrates a code editor, terminal, browser, project tools, AI agent, and desktop automation into a single application for serious project work.
key_features: AI agent for codebase inspection and file modification
Integrated terminal, browser, and file explorer
Support for local projects, GitHub repositories, and SSH workspaces
MCP (Model Control Plane) and Skills integration
Desktop automation capabilities with explicit approval controls
Monaco-based editor
primary_use_case: To provide a unified, AI-powered development environment for complex software projects, enabling controlled and efficient interaction with code, tools, and AI agents.
cover_image_prompt: A wise, anthropomorphic crab wearing a tiny hard hat, diligently organizing a bustling workshop filled with intricate gears, glowing circuits, and various tools. The crab is shown using a magnifying glass to inspect a complex blueprint (representing code) and a small, robotic arm to precisely place a component (representing file modification). Input streams of data flow from a 'cloud' icon and a 'terminal' icon towards the crab's workbench. The output is a perfectly assembled, intricate clockwork mechanism. Subtle UI elements resembling code editor windows and AI chat interfaces are visible on small screens around the workshop. The scene is rendered in a warm, inviting, 3D isometric illustration style with a focus on detail and clarity, emphasizing the crab's role as a central orchestrator of complex development tasks.

name: ChatGPT-Product-Info
description: A Chrome extension for extracting GEO/AEO, source, citation, product, and offer intelligence from ChatGPT conversations.
readme_summary: This Chrome extension extracts and organizes valuable intelligence from ChatGPT conversations, including product information, sources, and citations. It allows users to save, inspect, and export this data locally, enhancing research capabilities without relying on external servers.
key_features: Extracts GEO/AEO, source, citation, product, and offer intelligence from ChatGPT conversations.
Normalizes and saves research signals from active ChatGPT sessions.
Organizes, inspects, and exports results locally.
Captures conversation details, fan-out queries, sources, citations, product carousels, and offer data.
Provides v2 highlights like cache-first saved conversations, a saved research library with projects and tags, and expanded source taxonomy.
Offers live offer hydration and flow export as SVG/PNG.
Includes a Deep Research tab for inspecting recoverable traces.
Exports current scans and saved libraries in various formats (JSON, CSV, SVG, PNG).
primary_use_case: To empower users to efficiently extract, analyze, and manage detailed product and research intelligence from their ChatGPT conversations for offline use and further analysis.
cover_image_prompt: A diligent librarian meticulously organizing a vast, glowing library where each book represents a ChatGPT conversation. The librarian is shown carefully extracting shimmering threads of information – labeled 'Sources,' 'Products,' 'Citations,' and 'Offers' – from open books. These threads are then woven into organized scrolls and digital displays on a nearby desk, showcasing organized data and visual flow diagrams. Subtle digital particles and faint UI elements hint at the underlying technology. The scene is set in a cozy, modern study with warm, inviting lighting, rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with clean lines and a focus on clarity.
